Best Monitors 2026

The monitor is what you actually look at, and it defines how good your hardware feels. The right panel matches your GPU's output to a resolution and refresh rate you'll genuinely use.

FROM THE SHOPWe see brand-new RTX cards plugged into 1080p 60Hz panels constantly. Match the monitor to the GPU so the spend shows on screen.
What to consider when choosing monitors:
  • Resolution — 1080p, 1440p, or 4K; balance against your GPU's strength
  • Refresh rate (Hz) — 144Hz+ transforms fast-paced gaming
  • Panel type — IPS for colour, VA for contrast, OLED for the best of both
  • Adaptive sync (G-Sync/FreeSync) and response time for smooth motion
COMMON MISTAKE
Buying a 4K 144Hz monitor your GPU can't drive. Match the panel to the card so you actually hit those frames.
